scope: FreeRTOS with STM32CubeF1 HAL on STM32F103RB; this fixed ADXL345 task uses polling on SPI1 with GPIOA/4 chip select. The standard covers caller-provided SPI bindings, polling transfers, and chip-select control; the sampling interval in sample_ref is application policy.

binding.configuration: Mode 3, 8-bit, MSB-first, <=5 MHz; caller supplies initialized handle.

operations.name: HAL_SPI_Transmit
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_SPI_Transmit(SPI_HandleTypeDef *hspi, uint8_t *pData, uint16_t Size, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: blocking polling write; checks HAL_StatusTypeDef result

operations.name: HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive(SPI_HandleTypeDef *hspi, uint8_t *pTxData, uint8_t *pRxData, uint16_t Size, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: blocking same-length full-duplex transfer; checks result

operations.name: HAL_GPIO_WritePin
operations.signature: void HAL_GPIO_WritePin(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint16_t GPIO_Pin, GPIO_PinState PinState)
operations.semantics: assert CS low for transfer and deassert it high after completion

task_binding.backend: STM32CubeF1 HAL SPI with FreeRTOS timing

facts.requirement: Retain the SPI_HandleTypeDef handle and the task's fixed SPI1/hspi1, SPI mode, and GPIOA/4 chip-select binding; the caller initializes the bus and passes it in.

Provide blocking HAL SPI write and synchronous transmit/receive APIs, with handle, TX/RX buffers, byte count, timeout, and HAL_StatusTypeDef return value, sufficient for the reference register writes, readbacks, and burst reads.
Provide HAL GPIO pin writes to assert chip select low before each SPI transaction and release it high afterward.
